# <playbook_cite>Following entry [Problem Solving Heuristics And Workflows: When a task involves responding to or fulfilling a contact's request]: (3) Gather data, (4) Apply criteria (director=Peter Jackson), (5) Verify before sending.</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Assuming the "Movie Recommendations" note contains the relevant Peter Jackson movie titles to recommend.</uncertainty>

# Login tokens
phone_pass=[x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password']
phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='2444880289', password=phone_pass)['access_token']

sn_password=[x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]['password']
sn_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password=sn_password)['access_token']

# Load movie recommendations note
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2705, access_token=sn_token)
content=note['content']

# Parse titles where a following line indicates director: Peter Jackson
lines=content.splitlines()
movies=[]
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.strip().startswith('The ') or line.strip().startswith('Inglourious') or line.strip().startswith('No Country') or line.strip().startswith('Forrest'):
        pass

# More robust: title lines are ones that don't start with '-' and are non-empty, and are not the heading.
# In this note format, each movie block begins with the title line, then ' - director:' line.
filtered_titles=[]
seen=set()
current_title=None
for line in lines:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    if line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith(' - '):
        # director line
        if 'director:' in line:
            director=line.split('director:',1)[1].strip()
            if director=='Peter Jackson' and current_title:
                if current_title not in seen:
                    filtered_titles.append(current_title)
                    seen.add(current_title)
        continue
    # Otherwise it's a title line
    current_title=line.strip()

print('Filtered titles (director=Peter Jackson):', filtered_titles)

# Send to Leslie (phone number from message history)
leslie_phone='7873383923'
message=', '.join(filtered_titles)
print('Sending message:', message)
resp=apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=leslie_phone, message=message, access_token=phone_token)
print('send response:', resp)

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [Task-completion: Call complete_task() when done].</playbook_cite>
resp=apis.supervisor.complete_task()
print(resp)
